answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A juniper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the harbor of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
